items_flat.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
items_flat.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
items_flat.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布已被 SpaceX 正式收購完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。
items_flat.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team can scale Grok’s software-engineering edge.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這把領先的 AI 編碼代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 生態，形成更緊密的資料回饋與分發迴路。成敗關鍵在於合併後的整合速度與能否快速放大 Grok 在軟體工程的優勢。
items_flat.quote: Cursor is now part of @SpaceX. Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
items_flat.quote_zh: Cursor 現在是 SpaceX 的一部分。今天我們正式完成收購。我們將加入 SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes August 2026 Risk Report under Responsible Scaling Policy
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 2026 年 8 月風險報告（Responsible Scaling Policy）
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released its second Risk Report (coverage to 15 July). It rates catastrophic risks from Mythos 5 and the stronger internal Model 2 as Low overall. Misalignment risk in high-stakes settings was raised from very low to low due to cybersecurity incidents; automated R&D risk remains Low but with reduced confidence as some evals saturate.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布第二份風險報告（涵蓋至 7 月 15 日）。對 Mythos 5 與更強的內部 Model 2 的災難性風險整體評為 Low。因網路安全相關事件，高風險場景的 misalignment 風險從 very low 調升至 low；自動化 R&D 風險仍為 Low，但因部分評估飽和而信心下降。
items_flat.analysis_en: The upward revision on misalignment and eval saturation highlight measurement challenges at the frontier even while absolute risk levels remain Low. Non-release of Model 2 prioritizes safety over immediate capability shipping.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 調升 misalignment 與評估飽和問題，凸顯前沿模型量測挑戰，即便絕對風險仍屬 Low。Model 2 暫不對外釋出，顯示 Anthropic 在能力與安全節奏上的審慎。
items_flat.quote: As part of our Responsible Scaling Policy, we publish regular Risk Reports. These share detailed information on the risks of our systems and how prepared we are to address them. Our second Risk Report is now available.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為 Responsible Scaling Policy 的一部分，我們定期發布風險報告。這些報告詳細說明我們系統的風險以及我們如何準備應對。第二份風險報告現已發布。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，迄今最強工作馬模型（編碼與代理）
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and is offered at an introductory price of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through end-2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，稱為迄今最強的工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。相較 3.6 Flash 在編碼基準大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%，DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並以每百萬 token $0.75/$3.75 的導入價提供至 2026 年底。
items_flat.analysis_en: Rapid iteration on the Flash line (3.5→3.7 in three months) keeps Google competitive on cost-sensitive agent workloads. The price cut plus measurable coding gains lower the barrier for production agents, though flagship Pro remains delayed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Flash 系列快速迭代（三個月內 3.5→3.7）讓 Google 在成本敏感的代理工作負載上保持競爭力。降價加上可量化的編碼提升，降低生產級代理門檻，但旗艦 Pro 仍延遲。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們在廣受使用的 Flash 系列基礎上推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，這是我們迄今最強的工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。

links.label: Google DeepMind / Google AI on X

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, up to 14× faster via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast 模式，Cerebras 最高 14 倍速
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, delivering up to 14× the speed of standard processing and up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. It launches first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers, with broader access as capacity grows.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式，透過 Cerebras 可達標準處理最高 14 倍速度，每秒最多 750 輸出 token。先在 OpenAI API 對選定客戶開放，隨容量擴充擴大存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ultra-low-latency frontier inference opens real-time use cases (voice, interactive coding, support) that were previously impractical. Success depends on how quickly capacity scales and whether quality holds under sustained high-speed load.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 超低延遲的前沿推論開啟先前不切實際的即時用例（語音、互動編碼、客服）。成敗取決於容量擴充速度，以及高負載下品質是否維持。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing an early look at Ultrafast, a new service tier that runs GPT‑5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than Standard processing, launching first in the OpenAI API. Powered by Cerebras, Ultrafast generates up to 750 output tokens per second.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們分享 Ultrafast 的早期樣貌，這是新服務層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 比標準處理最高快 14 倍，先在 OpenAI API 推出。由 Cerebras 驅動，每秒可產生最多 750 輸出 token。

items_flat.title_en: SpaceXAI makes Grok 4.6 available in GitHub Copilot
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for VS Code, the Copilot CLI, cloud agents and other products. Users select it from the model picker; some Business/Enterprise plans require admin enablement. Pricing via SpaceXAI console is $2/$6 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已在 GitHub Copilot（VS Code、CLI、雲端代理等）上線。使用者可從模型選擇器選用；部分 Business/Enterprise 方案需管理員啟用。SpaceXAI 控制台定價為每百萬 token $2/$6。
items_flat.analysis_en: Placing Grok inside Microsoft’s dominant coding distribution channel intensifies competition for developer mindshare and usage data. Admin opt-in and gradual rollout may temper immediate share gains.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把 Grok 放進微軟主導的編碼分發通道，加劇開發者心智與使用資料競爭。管理員 opt-in 與漸進 rollout 可能緩和短期市占提升。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for the millions of developers who work in VS Code and across GitHub every day. Open the model picker and select "Grok 4.6" to start using our latest coding model.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 現已在 GitHub Copilot 上線，供每天使用 VS Code 與 GitHub 的數百萬開發者使用。打開模型選擇器選「Grok 4.6」即可開始使用我們最新的編碼模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic details Claude’s text watermark for EU AI Act compliance
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 詳述 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published a detailed explanation of how future Claude models will embed an invisible text watermark based on Google DeepMind’s SynthID-Text approach. The method alters randomness in word selection using a secret key, has no practical impact on quality or cost, and is undetectable to readers while allowing probabilistic detection with the key.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 詳細說明未來 Claude 模型如何嵌入不可見文字浮水印（基於 Google DeepMind SynthID-Text 方法）。此法用密鑰改變選詞隨機性，對品質與成本無實際影響，讀者無法察覺，但持有密鑰者可進行機率性偵測。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is industry-wide regulatory compliance rather than a capability advance. Detection is only probabilistic and weak on short, factual or code text; real-world robustness against adversarial removal remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產業層級的法規遵循，而非能力突破。偵測僅為機率性，對短文、事實或程式碼文本較弱；對抗移除的實際強健性尚未驗證。
items_flat.quote: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 未來 Claude 模型產生的文字將包含浮水印。這是判斷 Claude 是否參與撰寫該文字的方法，我們與其他主要 AI 供應商一同實施此變更以符合歐盟 AI 法。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI named Dali Rajic (formerly President & COO of Wiz) as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization. He succeeds Denise Dresser, who is departing after a transition period.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命前 Wiz 總裁暨營運長 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長，領導全球營收組織。他接替 Denise Dresser，後者將在過渡期後離職。
items_flat.analysis_en: The appointment signals continued focus on enterprise scale and go-to-market discipline amid rapid revenue growth and executive turnover. It comes as OpenAI prepares for a potential IPO.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示 OpenAI 在營收快速成長與高階主管流動中，持續聚焦企業規模與 go-to-market 紀律。時機正值公司準備潛在 IPO。
items_flat.quote: Dali Rajic will be joining as Chief Revenue Officer, leading OpenAI’s global revenue organization. ... Dali will build the revenue operating system needed to scale for this next phase.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dali Rajic 將加入擔任首席營收長，領導 OpenAI 全球營收組織。……Dali 將打造下一階段規模化所需的營收作業系統。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT desktop on Mac gains Computer History feature
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Mac 桌面版新增 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI rolled out Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac that lets the model remember activity across selected apps and websites. It builds a timeline and can suggest skills or automations from recurring tasks; it replaces the earlier Chronicle screenshot-based preview and uses accessibility events.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出 opt-in 的 Computer History 功能，讓模型記住選定 App 與網站的活動。它建立時間軸，並可從重複任務建議技能或自動化；取代先前以截圖為主的 Chronicle 預覽，改用 accessibility 事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from screenshot-based Chronicle to accessibility-event history reduces friction and privacy concerns while enabling deeper personalization. Adoption will hinge on user trust in local processing and control over which apps contribute data.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從截圖式 Chronicle 轉向 accessibility 事件歷史，降低摩擦與隱私顧慮，同時啟用更深個人化。採用率取決於使用者對本地處理的信任，以及對哪些 App 貢獻資料的控制感。
items_flat.quote: Computer History is an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS that turns activity across apps and websites into memories and a timeline that ChatGPT and Codex can use.
items_flat.quote_zh: Computer History 是 ChatGPT macOS 桌面版的 opt-in 功能，將跨 App 與網站的活動轉成記憶與時間軸，供 ChatGPT 與 Codex 使用。

items_flat.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
items_flat.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開放模型現況報告
items_flat.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference, followed by Gemma, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
items_flat.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開放模型現況觀察。主要發現包括前沿模型持續變大（尤其中國實驗室）、小模型仍主導真實下載量、Qwen 領先本地推論（其次 Gemma），以及 AI agents 成為 Hub 上的重要力量。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models rather than pure frontier size.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告量化中國開源權重在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小、高效模型主導，而非純粹前沿規模。
items_flat.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
items_flat.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開放模型現況 ☀️ 前沿模型持續變大，但小模型仍主導真實世界使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI agents 正成為 Hub 上的重要力量。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
items_flat.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and data centers.
items_flat.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，基於 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 開發下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季亮相。合作也擴及 AI 基礎設施、實體 AI 與資料中心。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether LG can translate simulation gains into commercial humanoids.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此協議凸顯 NVIDIA 將機器人堆疊嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的策略。成敗取決於 GR00T 系統的真實世界可靠性，以及 LG 能否將模擬優勢轉化為商業人形機器人。
items_flat.quote: LG today announced they're developing a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot built using NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, NVIDIA's open reasoning humanoid foundation model, for a public unveiling in the first quarter of next year.
items_flat.quote_zh: LG 今日宣布正在開發下一代雙足人形機器人，採用 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T（NVIDIA 開放推理人形基礎模型），目標明年第一季公開。

anthropic.quote: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act.
anthropic.quote_zh: 未來 Claude 模型產生的文字將包含浮水印。這是判斷 Claude 是否參與撰寫該文字的方法，我們與其他主要 AI 供應商一同實施此變更以符合歐盟 AI 法。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，迄今最強工作馬模型（編碼與代理）
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and is offered at an introductory price of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through end-2026.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，稱為迄今最強的工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。相較 3.6 Flash 在編碼基準大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%，DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並以每百萬 token $0.75/$3.75 的導入價提供至 2026 年底。
google.analysis_en: Rapid iteration on the Flash line (3.5→3.7 in three months) keeps Google competitive on cost-sensitive agent workloads. The price cut plus measurable coding gains lower the barrier for production agents, though flagship Pro remains delayed.
google.analysis_zh: Flash 系列快速迭代（三個月內 3.5→3.7）讓 Google 在成本敏感的代理工作負載上保持競爭力。降價加上可量化的編碼提升，降低生產級代理門檻，但旗艦 Pro 仍延遲。
google.quote: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們在廣受使用的 Flash 系列基礎上推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，這是我們迄今最強的工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。

links.label: Google DeepMind / Google AI on X

xai.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
xai.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
xai.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself.
xai.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布已被 SpaceX 正式收購完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。
xai.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team can scale Grok’s software-engineering edge.
xai.analysis_zh: 這把領先的 AI 編碼代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 生態，形成更緊密的資料回饋與分發迴路。成敗關鍵在於合併後的整合速度與能否快速放大 Grok 在軟體工程的優勢。
xai.quote: Cursor is now part of @SpaceX. Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
xai.quote_zh: Cursor 現在是 SpaceX 的一部分。今天我們正式完成收購。我們將加入 SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

xai.title_en: SpaceXAI makes Grok 4.6 available in GitHub Copilot
xai.title_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot
xai.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for VS Code, the Copilot CLI, cloud agents and other products. Users select it from the model picker; some Business/Enterprise plans require admin enablement. Pricing via SpaceXAI console is $2/$6 per million tokens.
xai.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已在 GitHub Copilot（VS Code、CLI、雲端代理等）上線。使用者可從模型選擇器選用；部分 Business/Enterprise 方案需管理員啟用。SpaceXAI 控制台定價為每百萬 token $2/$6。
xai.analysis_en: Placing Grok inside Microsoft’s dominant coding distribution channel intensifies competition for developer mindshare and usage data. Admin opt-in and gradual rollout may temper immediate share gains.
xai.analysis_zh: 把 Grok 放進微軟主導的編碼分發通道，加劇開發者心智與使用資料競爭。管理員 opt-in 與漸進 rollout 可能緩和短期市占提升。
xai.quote: Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for the millions of developers who work in VS Code and across GitHub every day. Open the model picker and select "Grok 4.6" to start using our latest coding model.
xai.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 現已在 GitHub Copilot 上線，供每天使用 VS Code 與 GitHub 的數百萬開發者使用。打開模型選擇器選「Grok 4.6」即可開始使用我們最新的編碼模型。

frontier_other.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
frontier_other.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開放模型現況報告
frontier_other.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference, followed by Gemma, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開放模型現況觀察。主要發現包括前沿模型持續變大（尤其中國實驗室）、小模型仍主導真實下載量、Qwen 領先本地推論（其次 Gemma），以及 AI agents 成為 Hub 上的重要力量。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models rather than pure frontier size.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 報告量化中國開源權重在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小、高效模型主導，而非純粹前沿規模。
frontier_other.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
frontier_other.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開放模型現況 ☀️ 前沿模型持續變大，但小模型仍主導真實世界使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI agents 正成為 Hub 上的重要力量。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and data centers.
frontier_other.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，基於 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 開發下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季亮相。合作也擴及 AI 基礎設施、實體 AI 與資料中心。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether LG can translate simulation gains into commercial humanoids.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此協議凸顯 NVIDIA 將機器人堆疊嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的策略。成敗取決於 GR00T 系統的真實世界可靠性，以及 LG 能否將模擬優勢轉化為商業人形機器人。
frontier_other.quote: LG today announced they're developing a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot built using NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, NVIDIA's open reasoning humanoid foundation model, for a public unveiling in the first quarter of next year.
frontier_other.quote_zh: LG 今日宣布正在開發下一代雙足人形機器人，採用 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T（NVIDIA 開放推理人形基礎模型），目標明年第一季公開。

brief_en: SpaceX closes Cursor acquisition into SpaceXAI to advance Grok; Anthropic publishes August Risk Report (Low overall risk, misalignment uptick) and details Claude text watermark for EU AI Act; Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash with coding gains and half-price intro rates; OpenAI previews Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol (up to 14× via Cerebras); Grok 4.6 arrives in GitHub Copilot.
brief_zh: SpaceX 正式完成 Cursor 收購並納入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok；Anthropic 發布 8 月風險報告（整體 Low，misalignment 上調）並詳述 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法；Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash（編碼大幅提升、半價導入）；OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast（Cerebras 最高 14 倍速）；Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot。
